notes_zh: 全部面积类指标来自本包 provisional 概念几何，属参与者临时模型数据：机器可校验的完整数值仅保留在此文件与 visual 页面的 data-value 中，人类可读展示一律就近取整。land_use 1401 比例与七类用地合计均按同一 EPSG:4548 聚合规则复算，七类合计 100.0%，无未分类/其他残差。官方数据发布后按同口径整体复算。

display_precision.rule: provisional values are displayed rounded (site area in ha with 0-1 decimals, ratios in percent with 1 decimal); full machine values kept for validation only
display_precision.example_display: site_area_sqm -> 约1141公顷; green_ratio -> 约11.0%; land_use_1401_ratio -> 约27.3%; public_space_ratio -> 约0.45%

assumptions: Provisional boundary, not an official redline; display rounded to ~1,141 ha (~11.4 km2, consistent with official announcement text caliber).

Concept greenline caliber; display rounded to ~126 ha; not the land-use-class park-green share (27.3%, metric land_use_1401_ratio) which uses a different layer. See proposal land-use caliber statement.
Concept public-space caliber; display rounded to ~5.2 ha.
Concept reuse-first envelopes; display rounded to ~11.2 ha.

Concept greenline caliber (green_space layer / site). The land-use-class park-green share is 27.3% (land_use 1401; five features aggregated from geometry/land_use.geojson) and is a different layer; both are explained in proposal.md. Display ~11.0%.
Five 1401 features are aggregated from the 27 land-use features; the seven code categories exhaust the file with no residual other/unclassified category.

land_use_1401_ratio.formula: sum(projected_area(feature) for land_use_code == '1401', EPSG:4548) / polygon_area(site_boundary, EPSG:4548)
assumptions: Computed from 3,116,095.041 sqm / 11,412,825.386 sqm = 27.30345%, displayed as approximately 27.3%; seven land-use codes sum to 100.0%, so no other 4.6% bucket is used.
Concept public-space caliber; display ~0.45%.
Concept network length; display ~10.2 km.
Three key areas per official announcement text; polygons provisional.

industry_test_scenario_count.formula: count(industry_validation scenario test protocols table rows)
assumptions: Three industry test protocols are explicitly listed in the proposal (产业测试场景（测试协议）table).

persona_count.formula: count(representative user groups in persona table)
assumptions: Six persona types: night commuter, young resident, visitor/tourist, stallholder, elderly nearby resident, night operation staff.
Six cases registered case-by-case in sources.json (CASE-SRC-* entries); claims are public-channel caliber only.
Three annual programme brands: Night Market Season, Summer Open Stage, Winter Light Festival (concepts).

ai_ecosystem_case_count.formula: count(rows in global AI innovation ecosystem benchmark table)
assumptions: Six global AI innovation ecosystem cases (ECOSYS-SRC-*) registered in sources.json; public-channel mechanism overviews only.

ai_ecosystem_element_count.formula: count(rows in the eight-element mechanism table: land, space, industry, capital, talent, compute, data, scenario)
assumptions: Eight elements per the land-space-industry-capital-talent-compute-data-scenario mechanism in proposal.md.

pilgrimage_landmark_count.formula: count(differentiated AI pilgrimage landmark concepts: Origin Ring, Echo Commons, Future Eye)
assumptions: Three differentiated AI pilgrimage-landmark concepts paired with the three functional night nodes; concept installations only.

honor_category_count.formula: count(honor display categories: open-source co-creation, community co-building, market reputation)
assumptions: Three honor categories with award rules, review and display surfaces in the honor display system table.

component_library_count.formula: count(rows in the reversible public-space component library table)
assumptions: Eight component types with spatial and operational mappings; mapped to public_space geometry.

communication_copy_count.formula: count(rows in the bilingual culture-narrative copy bank table)
assumptions: Six reusable bilingual copy blocks (mission, elevator pitch, wayfinding, invitation, disclosure intro, media one-liner).

developer_mechanism_count.formula: count(rows in the developer community operation mechanism table)
assumptions: Four developer-community mechanisms (partner plan, community rhythm, asset opening rules, operation support); concept-level.

conversion_step_count.formula: count(rows in the non-committal talent/enterprise/developer conversion pathway table)
assumptions: Four non-committal steps: experiencer, co-creator, pilot participant, ecosystem partner.
